situation: An employer hiring customer service agents for a new team through panel interviews.
complication: Screened candidates outnumber the panels the free manager hours allow, and some booked candidates do not attend.
key_question: How should the panel interviews be scheduled so every screened candidate is seen in time?

titles.risks: The main risk is candidates dropping out while they wait.

work.title: Panel interview invitation
work.for: Screened candidates, email for the customer service manager to approve before sending
body: Hello, thank you for speaking with us. We would like to invite you to a panel interview for the customer service agent role.
The interview lasts about an hour, with two of our team managers. {Interview format, for the customer service manager to confirm.}
Please reply with your choice of these slots: {first slot}, {second slot}, {third slot}. If none of them work, tell us and we will find another time.
We will send a reminder the day before. If your plans change, just reply to this email so we can offer the slot to someone else.
We look forward to meeting you. The recruiting team.
